messages:
lina: heads-up — deploy-bot held the prod promotion for 2026.03.20-rc3. :warning:
deploy-bot: Release promotion blocked: missing secret path `secrets.kvPrefix` for service `inference-router` in prod (found in staging). Reason: env parity check failed. See /deploy/logs/1993056789.
lina: repro steps: ran `env-compare --from staging --to prod --service inference-router` and it flagged `SECRETS.KV_PREFIX` present in staging only.
sam: ugh. was this introduced by the helm values refactor last week?
ryan: maybe. last helm change switched to camelCase keys: `kvPrefix` vs `kv_prefix`. staging helm release still has legacy mapping via a values-override. prod uses the chart default.
lina: confirmed: staging has DOCKER_IMAGE=redwood/inference:2026.03.18 and prod image is pinned to :2026.03.05. but secrets differ too.
sam: deploy timeline: we scheduled change window now. we should decide rollback vs backfill. thoughts?
ryan: short term: backfill prod secret path with the staging key name to unblock. long term: align chart keys and add parity test to pipeline.
oncall-bot: @oncall assigned to @ryan (24/7 rotation).
ryan: i'll create the secret patch with the staged value but will mark as temporary. command: `kubectl -n prod create secret generic inference-kv --from-literal=KV_PREFIX="/kv/inference" --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -`
sam: if we backfill, we still need to ensure image differences won't cause other surprises. can we promote the older pinned image?
lina: given rc3 includes a fix in the runtime for attention kernel, prefer to promote rc3 once prod parity is restored. so backfill secret now, re-run env-compare, then unhold.
ryan: will patch prod secret in 5m and post results.
arrFragments: :thumbsup: (reactions collected)
ryan: patched prod secret and re-ran env-compare. result: parity check passed except for one remaining entry: `featureFlags.experimentalApi` (staging=true, prod=false).
sam: experimentalApi must remain off in prod until QA sign-off. do not change.
lina: deploy-bot, please re-run the promotion after the secret patch and block if any non-whitelisted keys differ. whitelist list: ["featureFlags.experimentalApi"]
deploy-bot: Re-check complete. Found only whitelisted differences. Promotion unblocked.
sam: ok promoting now. rolling Canary to 10% then 50%. watch telemetry.
oncall-bot: Canary healthcheck alert: increased 5xx rate on inference-router-canary-1 at +1.2%.
ryan: pulling logs: `ERROR KeyError: 'kvPrefix' in router/config_loader.py` — looks like new runtime reads camelCase key `kvPrefix`, but our secret backfill used snake_case key `KV_PREFIX`.
lina: oh — so the application expects camelCase but our backfill used legacy key. we need to sync the secret payload shape, not just key name.
sam: rollback the promotion to stop Canary.
ryan: rolling back canary now, switching traffic back to baseline.
engine-bot: Rollback complete. Canary terminated.
ryan: next steps: 1) create secret with both keys (KV_PREFIX and kvPrefix) and ensure the app reads either. 2) add an env-parity integration test to detect key-name casing diffs. 3) create follow-up issue to unify chart to camelCase and migrate staging overrides.
lina: I'll file the follow-up and assign to infra + release owners. also adding release note: "Blocked promotion due to secret key naming mismatch between staging and prod; temporary backfill applied and rollback executed to fix payload shape."
sam: thanks team. postmortem item: make deploy-bot parity checks include secret payload keys and value shapes, not just presence.
ryan: will open PR for secret helper and update runbook. ETA EOD.
lina: closing thread once PR merged and we re-run a successful canary.
